description: Ministry of Lands & Parliament Rectams  -  Appoint Mr. A. H. Sarath Laxman as Acquiring Officer for the Central Expressway Project in the Gampaha District w.e.f. 30.04.2017 to 31.12.2017 Appoint Mri K. M. Ariyarathne and Three Others as Acquiring Officers for weras Ganga Storm Water Drainage and Environment Improvement Project w.e.f. 02.02.2017 to 02.02.2019
reasoning: This gazette contains both government personnel appointments (naming specific individuals like Mr. A. H. Sarath Laxman and Mr. K. M. Ariyarathne) AND detailed portfolio responsibilities (specifying they are appointed as Acquiring Officers under the Land Acquisition Act to function for specific land acquisition projects like the Central Expressway Project and Weras Ganga Project). This combination of named individuals with specific responsibilities makes it a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
